hooks.name: Curiosity + Timeframe
hooks.description: Create immediate interest with time constraint
hooks.example: Build a RAG system in 15 minutes. No LangChain. No vector DB. Just Python + Claude.

hooks.name: Contrarian Take + Proof
hooks.example: Everyone says AI agents need 10k examples to train. But we got 95% accuracy with just 100 examples.

hooks.name: Problem + Agitate + Solve
hooks.description: Identify pain point, escalate it, provide answer
hooks.example: Struggling with LLM hallucinations? RAG isn't enough—you need retrieval ranking. Here's how.

hooks.name: Number + Insight
hooks.description: Numbers grab attention, insights add value
hooks.example: 5 things I learned after building 100 AI agents for clients

hooks.name: Before/After
hooks.example: From manual data entry to fully automated—saved 40 hours/week in 2 weeks

hooks.name: Question + Answer
hooks.example:
Q: Can you build production AI without GPUs?
A: Yes. Here's how with Claude API.

hooks.name: Story + Lesson
hooks.description: Tell relatable story, extract actionable lesson
hooks.example: Wasted $50k on ML infrastructure. Lesson: Use APIs first, optimize later.

hooks.name: Mistake + Learning
hooks.example: Biggest mistake: Building custom LLM. Now I use Claude APIs and ship 10x faster.

hooks.name: Benchmark + Ranking
hooks.example: Tested 5 RAG frameworks. Winner: LangChain because of ecosystem maturity.

hooks.name: Hype Check
hooks.template: [Buzzword] is great, but here's the reality.
hooks.example: AI agents are amazing, but 80% of use cases need simple orchestration, not full autonomy.

hooks.name: Counterintuitive Insight
hooks.example: Counterintuitive: The best RAG isn't about more documents. It's about better retrieval ranking.

hooks.name: Framework + Template
hooks.description: Provide repeatable system or mental model
hooks.example: Here's my 3-step framework for building production AI: API → Observe → Optimize

hooks.name: Prediction + Why
hooks.description: Make bold claim backed by logic
hooks.example: Prediction: RAG will be obsolete by 2027. Why? Better LLM context windows eliminate retrieval.

hooks.name: Resource Reveal
hooks.template: I'm sharing my [X]. Thousands use it.
hooks.description: Offer valuable tool/resource with social proof
hooks.example: I'm sharing my prompt template library. 5000+ engineers use it for agentic workflows.

hooks.name: Comparison Matrix
hooks.template: Comparing [X]: [Option A] vs [Option B] vs [Option C]
hooks.example: Comparing RAG implementations: LangChain vs LlamaIndex vs Custom (with trade-offs)

hooks.name: What I Got Wrong
hooks.template: I was wrong about [X]. The truth is [Y].
hooks.description: Show growth and admit mistakes—builds trust
hooks.example: I was wrong about needing fine-tuning. Prompt engineering + RAG is 90% of the battle.

hooks.name: Trend Analysis
hooks.template: The [trend] in AI is [direction]. Here's what it means.
hooks.example: The shift from fine-tuning to in-context learning means API-first architectures win.

hooks.name: Personal Principle
hooks.template: Principle I live by: [X]. Apply it to [domain].
hooks.example: Principle: 'Complexity is the enemy.' Apply to AI: Start with simplest solution that works.

hooks.name: Behind The Scenes
hooks.description: Pull back curtain on process—builds authenticity
hooks.example: Behind the scenes of building our AI platform: 60% architecture decisions, 30% infra, 10% code.

hooks.name: Milestone + Reflection
hooks.example: 1000 customers reached. What I've learned: Product > marketing. API design > features.

hooks.name: Code Snippet Reveal
hooks.example: Here's the 10-line code that replaces a $500/month service with Claude API.
